methodology: Offline replay of all 2104 memory candidates in 102 complete v4 extraction receipts. Candidate classification calls current Rust ai::checked_candidate and memory_facts::extraction_check. No model calls, document imports, candidate confirmations, database mutations, or gold answers. Categories are disjoint and do not measure semantic correctness. Old 6000-character response batches are not rerun: v5 quantity overflow is reported separately, so per-candidate ready does not mean these old batches would be accepted by v5.
